question: Stable town URL to use as website

question: Is our market the Herbstmarkt's flea market or a separate children's flea market?
answer: A companion children's flea market, not the Herbstmarkt itself. The town lists ONE combined event called 'Herbst- und Kinderflohmarkt', venue Kirchgasse 8952 Schlieren (Sat, 9:00-16:00). The Herbstmarkt (food, crafts, club info stands) is the Kirchgasse market; the Kinderflohmarkt is held 'gleichzeitig' (at the same time) on a meadow on Freiestrasse. Ours (kind kinderflohmarkt, 5 Sep 2026, 09:00-16:00) is the children's one, so Kirchgasse is the Herbstmarkt's venue, not ours. Caveat: the town's 2026 event page is gone (HTTP 410), so this wording is from the Wayback copy of the town's page (2025 edition, Sa 6 Sep 2025); the 2026 Merkblatt confirms the children's market on its own meadow, same hours, 5 Sep 2026. The meadow is described as 'Ecke Freiestrasse/Stationsstrasse' in 2025 and 'zwischen Stadthaus und Stürmeierhuus' in 2026 - both on Freiestrasse, probably the same spot.
quote: Der Kinderflohmarkt findet gleichzeitig auf der Wiese an der Ecke Freiestrasse/Stationsstrasse statt.
